privacy_policy.str_7: Welcome to {Melon}. Infera Inc. (“{Melon},” “we,” “us,” or “our”) is committed to protecting your privacy. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, store, share, and protect your personal information when you use our Service, as defined in our Terms of Service.
privacy_policy.str_8: This Policy is designed to be transparent and to help you understand your privacy rights. It applies to all services offered by {Melon}. The data controller responsible for your information is Infera Inc., with its registered address at 8th Floor, Block A, Huizhi Building, No. 28 Ningshuang Road, Tiexinqiao Street, Yuhua tai District, Nanjing, China.
privacy_policy.str_9: By using our Service, you agree to the collection and use of information in accordance with this Policy.
privacy_policy.str_11: We collect information to provide and improve our Service. The types of information we collect are described below.
privacy_policy.str_14: When you create a {Melon} account, we collect your mobile phone number or email address and your encrypted password.
privacy_policy.str_16: We collect the content you provide to the Service. This includes text, documents, and images for translation; lyrics for music generation; and, critically, voice and audio recordings for features like voice translation, AI covers, and voice cloning.This data is essential for the core functionality of the Service.
privacy_policy.str_18: If you contact us for customer support or provide feedback, we will collect the information you include in your communications.
privacy_policy.str_21: We automatically collect information about your interactions with the Service, such as the features you use, the actions you take, and the time, frequency, and duration of your activities.
privacy_policy.str_23: We collect information from and about the device(s) you use to access our Service. This includes your IP address, device model, operating system version, unique device identifiers, and network information.
privacy_policy.str_25: If you choose to register or log in to our Service using a third-party account (such as Google or Apple), we will receive certain profile information about you from that service, such as your name and email address, as permitted by you and the policies of that third-party service.
privacy_policy.str_26: 2.3.1 Summary of Personal Data Processing Activities
privacy_policy.str_27: To ensure transparency, particularly for our users in the European Economic Area (EEA), The following summarizes our data processing activities.
privacy_policy.str_28: 1) Account Credentials (Phone number or email, password): To create, manage, and secure your account; to verify your identity.
privacy_policy.str_29: 2) User Input (Text, documents, images, audio/voice recordings): To provide the core AI translation and music generation services you request.
privacy_policy.str_30: 3) User Input & Usage Data: To train, develop, and improve our AI models and the overall Service.
privacy_policy.str_31: 4) Payment Information (Processed by third parties): To process your purchases of virtual Credits.
privacy_policy.str_32: 5) Device & Log Information: To ensure the security and stability of the Service; to prevent fraud and abuse.
privacy_policy.str_33: 6) Communications Data: To respond to your support requests and feedback.
privacy_policy.str_34: 3. How and Why We Use Your Information (Purposes of Processing)
privacy_policy.str_35: We use the information we collect for the following purposes:
privacy_policy.str_36: To Provide and Maintain the Service:
privacy_policy.str_37: We use your information to deliver the core functionalities of the Service, such as processing your Input to generate Output, managing your account, and processing payments. The legal basis for this processing is the performance of our contract (our Terms of Service) with you.
privacy_policy.str_38: To Improve and Develop the Service:
privacy_policy.str_39: We use your Input and Usage Data to train our AI models and improve the quality, accuracy, and features of our Service. This processing is based on our legitimate interest in developing a state-of-the-art AI service. Providing an easy-to-use opt-out strengthens the justification for this legitimate interest and aligns with principles of user control central to modern privacy laws like GDPR and the California Privacy Rights Act (CPRA).
privacy_policy.str_40: You are in control. You can opt out of having your data used for AI model improvement at any time in your account settings. Your choice will not affect your access to the core features of the Service.
privacy_policy.str_42: We use your contact information to send you service-related announcements, security alerts, and support messages. This is based on our legitimate interest in keeping you informed about your account and the Service.
privacy_policy.str_44: We use devices and log information to protect the security and integrity of our Service, prevent fraud and abuse, and enforce our Terms. This processing is based on our legitimate interest and, in some cases, our legal obligations.
privacy_policy.str_45: 4. How We Share and Disclose Information
privacy_policy.str_46: We do not share your personal information with third parties except in the limited circumstances described below:
privacy_policy.str_48: We share information with third-party vendors and partners who work on our behalf, such as cloud hosting providers (e.g., AWS, Google Cloud), payment processors, and analytics services. These providers are contractually obligated to protect your information and are prohibited from using it for any other purpose.
privacy_policy.str_50: We may disclose your information if we believe it is reasonably necessary to comply with a law, regulation, legal process, or governmental request; to enforce our Terms; to protect the safety of any person; or to address fraud, security, or technical issues.
privacy_policy.str_51: In Case of a Business Transfer:

privacy_policy.str_54: We may share your information with third parties when we have your explicit consent to do so.
privacy_policy.str_55: We do not sell your personal information.
privacy_policy.str_56: This is a key commitment and a requirement for compliance with laws like the CCPA/CPRA.
privacy_policy.str_58: Your personal information may be transferred to, and processed in, countries other than the country in which you are a resident. Our company is based in China, and we may use servers and service providers located in various countries, including the United States.
privacy_policy.str_59: These countries may have data protection laws that are different from the laws of your country. Specifically, for users in the EEA, UK, or Switzerland, when we transfer your personal information to a country that has not been deemed to provide an adequate level of data protection by the European Commission (such as China or the United States prior to the EU-U.S. Data Privacy Framework), we do so on the basis of appropriate safeguards. The primary mechanism we rely on for such transfers is the Standard Contractual Clauses (SCCs) approved by the European Commission. This is a legally mandated requirement under GDPR to ensure your data remains protected to EU standards when it leaves the EEA.
privacy_policy.str_61: You have rights and choices regarding your personal information. We have organized these rights by jurisdiction for your convenience.
privacy_policy.str_63: Regardless of your location, you have the right to:
privacy_policy.str_69: your personal information by deleting your account.
privacy_policy.str_70: Control Data Use for AI Improvement:

privacy_policy.str_72: 6.2 Your Rights as a Resident of the EEA, UK, or Switzerland (GDPR)
privacy_policy.str_73: If you are a resident of the EEA, UK, or Switzerland, you have the following additional rights under the GDPR:
privacy_policy.str_75: You have the right to object to our processing of your personal data when it is based on our legitimate interests.
privacy_policy.str_77: You can ask us to restrict the processing of your personal data in certain circumstances.
privacy_policy.str_79: You have the right to receive the personal data you have provided to us in a structured, commonly used, and machine-readable format.
privacy_policy.str_81: You have the right to lodge a complaint with a data protection supervisory authority in your country of residence.
privacy_policy.str_82: 6.3 Your Rights as a Resident of California (CCPA/CPRA)
privacy_policy.str_83: If you are a California resident, you have the following rights under the California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA), as amended by the California Privacy Rights Act (CPRA):
privacy_policy.str_85: You have the right to request information about the categories and specific pieces of personal information we have collected about you, the sources of that information, the purposes for which we use it, and the third parties with whom we share it.
privacy_policy.str_87: You have the right to request the deletion of your personal information that we have collected, subject to certain exceptions.
privacy_policy.str_89: You have the right to request the correction of inaccurate personal information we maintain about you.
privacy_policy.str_91: We do not “sell” or “share” (for cross-context behavioral advertising) your personal information as those terms are defined under the CCPA/CPRA.
privacy_policy.str_92: Right to Limit Use and Disclosure of Sensitive Personal Information:
privacy_policy.str_93: You have the right to limit our use of your sensitive personal information (such as voice recordings) to that which is necessary to perform the services you requested. Our feature allowing you to opt out of AI model training is one way we honor this right.
privacy_policy.str_95: We will not discriminate against you for exercising any of your CCPA/CPRA rights.
privacy_policy.str_96: To exercise any of these rights, please contact us using the information provided in Section 9.
privacy_policy.str_98: We implement commercially reasonable technical and organizational security measures designed to protect your personal information from unauthorized access, use, alteration, or disclosure. These measures include encryption of data in transit and at rest, and strict access controls.
privacy_policy.str_99: We retain your personal information for as long as your account is active or as needed to provide you with the Service. We may also retain information for a longer period as necessary to comply with our legal obligations, resolve disputes, and enforce our agreements. After this period, we will delete or anonymize your information.
privacy_policy.str_101: Our Service is not directed to individuals under the age of 13 (or 16 in the EEA, where applicable). We do not knowingly collect personal information from children. privacy_policy.str_103: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. If we make material changes, we will notify you through the Service or by other means, such as email, to provide you with the opportunity to review the changes before they become effective.
